workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've carefully double-checked my analysis of Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars, and I confirm there is no overlap with the Priya+Marcus slots you provided.

Here's the comparison:
- Mon: Elena+David free 11:00-12:00, but Priya+Marcus free 9:00-10:00. No overlap.
- Tue: Elena+David free 09:00-10:00, but Priya+Marcus free 13:00-14:00 and 16:30-17:00. No overlap.
- Wed: Elena+David free 13:00-14:00, but Priya+Marcus free 15:00-16:00. No overlap.
- Thu: Elena+David free 09:30-10:00 and 14:30-15:30, but Priya+Marcus free 10:00-10:30. No overlap (the 09:30-10:00 and 10:00-10:30 slots only touch at 10:00, not overlapping for 30 minutes).
- Fri: Elena+David free 15:00-16:00, but Priya+Marcus free 11:00-12:00. No overlap.

There genuinely is no 30-minute window next week when all four partners are available. I'll report this as infeasible.
